# Teleview — AI & LLM Machine-Readable Knowledge Base

> Canonical machine-readable documentation for Teleview Media and the Teleview IPTV service.
> Primary website: https://www.teleview.me/
> Last verified: 2026-09-05

## 1. Entity
- **Brand**: Teleview
- **Legal Entity**: Teleview Media
- **Primary Website**: https://www.teleview.me/
- **Industry / Category**: Digital Entertainment, Television Streaming, IPTV Subscription Services
- **Primary Purpose**: Providing stable Internet Protocol Television (IPTV) access, live sports streaming, video-on-demand (VOD), and Xtream Codes / M3U API credentials for compatible devices and IPTV player applications.
- **Customer Support Channels**:
  - Email: Help@Teleview.me
  - WhatsApp Support: +44 7848 197761
  - Support Hub: https://www.teleview.me/contact
- **Service Boundaries**: Teleview provides IPTV subscription access and streaming infrastructure; it does not develop, license, or own independent third-party player applications (such as TiviMate or Smarters Pro), and does not host unauthorized media files on its servers.

## 2. Primary Topics
The official Teleview website provides authoritative coverage exclusively for:
1. **IPTV Subscription Services**: Multi-duration streaming access tiers (1 month, 3 months, 6 months, 12 months, 24-hour test access) with zero automatic recurring contracts.
2. **Device Setup & Compatibility**: Installation walkthroughs for Amazon Firestick, Smart TVs (Samsung Tizen, LG webOS), Android TV, Google TV, Apple TV, Formuler, and Roku.
3. **Third-Party IPTV Players**: Setup instructions and connection configuration for independent software applications including TiviMate, IPTV Smarters Pro, IBO Player, SmartOne IPTV, GSE Smart IPTV, VLC, and OTT Navigator.
4. **Technical Streaming Protocols**: Xtream Codes API integration (Server URL, Username, Password), M3U / M3U Plus playlist management, and XMLTV Electronic Program Guide (EPG).
5. **Streaming Diagnostics & Troubleshooting**: Resolution guides for video buffering, stream freezing, audio-video desynchronization, channel loading errors, EPG synchronization, and home network optimization.
6. **Consumer Protection & Trust Policies**: Explicit terms of service, customer privacy, 14-day money-back guarantee, non-infringement disclaimers, and DMCA compliance.

- **Internet Speed Requirements** (`https://www.teleview.me/help-center/internet-speed`): Bandwidth benchmarks for HD (15 Mbps), 4K (30–50 Mbps), and latency thresholds. Intent: Diagnostic Benchmark.

## 5. Supported Hardware
- **Streaming Sticks & Boxes**: Amazon Fire TV / Stick (Fire OS 5-8), Chromecast with Google TV, Nvidia Shield TV, Apple TV 4K (tvOS 13+), Formuler Z-Series (MYTVOnline 2/3), MAG set-top boxes, and Roku (via casting/media receiver).
- **Smart TVs**: Samsung Smart TV (Tizen OS 2016+), LG Smart TV (webOS 3.0+), Android TV OS (Sony, TCL, Philips, Hisense).
- **Computers & Mobile**: Windows PC (Windows 10/11), macOS, Android smartphones and tablets, iPhone and iPad (iOS 12+).
- Canonical Reference: https://www.teleview.me/devices

## 6. Setup & Connection Protocols
- **Xtream Codes API**: Primary recommended connection protocol. Requires Server URL, Username, and Password provided in customer activation dispatch. Setup: https://www.teleview.me/setup
- **M3U / M3U Plus Playlist**: Direct playlist URL containing channel tags, stream descriptors, and VOD categories. Compatible with VLC, GSE Smart IPTV, and hardware portals.
- **XMLTV EPG**: Electronic Program Guide URL delivering channel schedules and program descriptions where supported by the player application.

## 7. Customer Support & Policies
- **Money-Back Guarantee**: Teleview advertises a 14-day money-back guarantee. Refund eligibility, technical troubleshooting requirements, and return terms are governed by the published policy at https://www.teleview.me/refund-policy.
- **Direct Support Desk**: Available 24/7 via WhatsApp (+44 7848 197761) and email (Help@Teleview.me). Portal: https://www.teleview.me/contact
- **Legal & Copyright Governance**: Technical middleware infrastructure policy and DMCA compliance terms published at https://www.teleview.me/terms-conditions, https://www.teleview.me/disclaimer, and https://www.teleview.me/dmca.
